title: Harnessing Dephasing for Quantum Reservoir Computing with a Minimum Complexity Architecture: Applications to Nonlinear Time-Series Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.26762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) exploits quantum dynamics for temporal information processing. Quantum noise affects the reservoir dynamics and can either impair computational performance or serve as a computational resource. However, the role of pure dephasing in Hamiltonian encoding QRC remains unclear. In this work, we propose a minimum complexity QRC model that harnesses pure dephasing in an open uniform XX chain. We show that, under suitable input encoding, pure dephasing can ensure the echo state and fading memory properties even without amplitude damping. Furthermore, in the presence of amplitude damping, the proposed quantum reservoir has distinct stationary states for distinct inputs, and introducing pure dephasing alters these states, thereby affecting the reservoir dynamics. translated_title: 利用退相位实现最小复杂度架构的量子储备池计算：在非线性时间序列预测中的应用
translated_abstract: 量子储备池计算（QRC）利用量子动力学进行时间信息处理。量子噪声会影响储备池动力学，它既可能损害计算性能，也可能作为一种计算资源。然而，纯退相位在哈密顿量编码的QRC中的作用仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个最小复杂度的QRC模型，该模型在开放的均匀XX链中利用纯退相位。我们证明，在适当的输入编码下，即使没有振幅阻尼，纯退相位也能确保回声态和衰减记忆特性。此外，在存在振幅阻尼的情况下，所提出的量子储备池对不同输入具有不同的稳态，而引入纯退相位会改变这些稳态，从而影响储备池动力学。信息处理能力分析表明，对这两种退相干机制的联合控制可以调节记忆与非线性能力，提供了可…
tldr: 提出了一种最小复杂度的量子储备池计算模型，证明纯退相位在开放均匀XX链中可保证回声态与衰减记忆特性，且联合控制退相位与振幅阻尼可调节记忆与非线性能力，成功应用于非线性时间序列预测。
en_tdlr: This work proposes a minimum-complexity quantum reservoir computing model that harnesses pure dephasing in an open uniform XX chain, demonstrating that pure dephasing can guarantee echo state and fading memory properties, and that joint control of dephasing and amplitude damping regulates memory and nonlinearity for nonlinear time-series prediction.
